definitions.simple_extraction: Answer is recoverable from one span or cell with no arithmetic and no dependent hop.
definitions.numerical_arithmetic: Requires an explicit arithmetic, percentage, or ratio operation with depth at most two.
definitions.multi_step_numerical_reasoning: Requires at least two dependent numerical operations or intermediate variables.
definitions.cross_row_column_table_reasoning: Requires evidence from at least two different table row/column/cell groups.
definitions.hierarchical_table_reasoning: A visible parent-child row hierarchy or multi-level column header exists, the question requires traversing that hierarchy, and a single-cell lookup is insufficient.
definitions.long_context_understanding: Rendered question context contains at least 2000 observable tokens.
definitions.multi_hop_reasoning: Evidence 1 yields an intermediate fact needed to identify or interpret Evidence 2.
definitions.evidence_synthesis: Answer integrates at least two independent, parallel evidence units without requiring a dependent chain.
definitions.compliance_regulation_reasoning: Answer requires applying an obligation, prohibition, permission, eligibility condition, regulatory threshold, exception, or compliance-status rule; mere extraction of regulatory text is insufficient.
definitions.ambiguity_negation_exception: A negation, exception, only-if condition, or genuine ambiguity changes the answer; incidental lexical occurrence is insufficient.
